description:
Tashkent Falcons is a creative and technology-driven team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge.

We are currently a team of two members: a Full-Stack Web Developer and a UI/UX Designer. We combine technical expertise with creativity to turn innovative ideas into engaging digital experiences.

For this challenge, we are developing LEGACY — Every Machine Has a Story, an interactive digital museum dedicated to NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars.
